tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ nā ge shwa ra rā dza sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar gnas khang nyams dga' bar kha gdong dag par byas nas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ 'byung po thams cad tshim par byed pa'i sngags/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twott oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ āḥbighnānta krit hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad bsal bar bya'o// de nas byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms sngon du song nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blos/ rang gi snying gar hūm̐ bai ḍūrya'i mdog lta bu las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis lus khyab nas rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi rgyal por gyur par bsam/ de nas snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i rim pa 'di yin te/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas me tog thogs pa'i lha mo sngon mos nam mkha' khengs pa dang*/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas bdug spos thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo dpag tu med pa dang*/ oṃ badzra dī paṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas mar me thogs pa'i lha mo dmar mos nam mkha' khengs pa dang*/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas dri mchog thogs pa'i lha mo ser mo dpag tu med pa dang*/

oṃ badzra nai wi dyā āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas zhal zas thogs pa'i lha mo ser skya ma dpag tu med pas mchod la/ oṃ sarba bi sho dha pū dza me gha sphā ra ṇa sa mu dra hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod pas de nyid la rin po che sna tshogs dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla re la sogs pa dang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod par bya'o// de nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub du bsngo ba dang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ lam bsten pa rnams bya'o// de nas ye shes kyi tshogs bskyed par bya ba'i phyir sngags 'di brjod par bya'o// oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad spros pa dang bral bar bsam/ de nas stong pa nyid la gnas pas sems can gyi don mi 'grub pas snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhig bsam/ de'i steng du chos thams cad mtha' dbus med par ston par byed pa'i yi ge a dkar po 'od du zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yangs shing rgya che bar gyur par bsam/ de'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ mi dpogs

'di'i mchan rnying par rin po che bai ḍūrya la rin po che gzhan gyi kha dog gis brnyas su med pas na mi dpogs pa'o// zhes 'byung*/ pa'i rin po che'i mdog lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag nas hūm̐ de nyid skad cig ma gcig la klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i skur gyur par bsam/ de'ang sku mdog mi dpogs pa'i rin po che'i mdog lta bu dbu la sbrul mgo bdun gdengs pa'i rgyab yol can/ chos gos dur smrig gsol ba/ dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ klu thams cad klu'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa dang*/ sems can thams cad ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang 'di la mchan rnying pa rnams las shin tu bcings shing bsdams pa zhes 'byung zhing*/ bris sku snga ma phal cher las kyang phyag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgreng ba g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis thugs kar bcangs pa zhig mdzad snang*/ bcom ldan ral gri man chod kyi yig char/ chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya nang du mdzad do// ldan pa/ bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan par bsam/ de'i mdun du byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba sku mdog dkar po rin po che'i myu gu phyag g.yas na bsnams pa/ g.yon bum pa bsnams pas/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'o// g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' byams pa sku mdog dmar po klu shing gi me tog dang*/ ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa/ rgyab tu byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu utpal bsnams pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po padma bsnams pa bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'o// g.yas phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs su dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsam/

'og gi phyogs su klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pas rin po che thogs pa thal mo sbyar ba kha gyen du blta bar bsam mo// de nas ye shes sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la mchod pa dang*/ gsol ba legs par btab la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i yi ge bzhis spyan drangs la/ dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dges par byas la snying po 'di brjod par bya'o// tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pas mdze'i nad thams cad dang*/ myong bar nges pa'i las thams cad zad par 'gyur ro// bum pa gnyis la gcig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs dang rin po che'i dang 'bru sna tshogs kyis dgang bar bya'o// gcig tu klu nor rgyas kyi bu la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzugs bcug la rin po che sna tshogs pa dang*/ klu sman sna tshogs pa dang*/ 'bru sna tshogs kyis legs par bkang la padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi khar bum pa gnyis po bzhag la/ ba dmar mo gnyis kyi 'o ma ma god pa dang*/ gdugs brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ a ga ru nag po'i bdug spos dang*/ ce pog spos dkar dkar po dang*/ bdug pa sna tshogs dang*/ me tog dang*/ mar me dang*/ lha bshos dang*/ rol mo sna tshogs pas mchod par bya'o// zhag bdun du snying po rgyun mi chad par bzlas na dbul ba thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// sad dang*/ ser ba dang*/ lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// bum pa gnyis po'ang 'og tu klu'i bum pa gzhag steng du bcom ldan 'das kyi bum pa bzhag nas/ gnas khang gi shar phyogs su gter du sbas na phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'gyur ro// klu'i gnod pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro// khyim de'i skyes pa dang bud med thams cad 'phel zhing dar bar 'gyur ro// char dbab pa ni bla gab med pa'i sa phyogs su bya'o// char gcod pa ni bcom ldan 'das la phul ba'i me tog la sbyin sreg bya'o// sa'i gter 'byin par 'dod na bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar rmi lam zhu bar bya'o// gtor ma gsum byas la gcig ni bcom ldan 'das la'o// gnyis pa ni 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la'o// gsum pa ni klu rnams la sbyin par bya'o// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya'o// de nas gshegs su gsol la/

thun mtshams su de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig re brjod par bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ kā ra shrī dzñā na dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ /sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po bsgom par 'dod na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas te/ snying ga'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros pas lus sbyangs nas/ rang nyid sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog sngon po/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ klu dang sems can thams cad ngan 'gro las thar bar byed pa'i chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ g.yas su byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ g.yon du dgra bcom pa du ma/ mdun du klu'i tshogs du ma bsams la ye shes pa gzhug sngags ni/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag bzlas pas nad thams cad dang*/ myong bar nges pa'i las thams cad 'dzad par 'gyur ro// mthar rim gyis bsdus te stong par bsgom/ thun mtshams su klu dbang gi rgyal po'i mtshan nyer gcig brjod/ gtor ma gsum byas nas bcom ldan 'das/ 'jig rten skyong ba/ klu dang gsum la a kā ro la sogs pas sbyin no// 'di'i bris sku yod pa'i sar klu nad 'byung mi srid/ 'di mdo me tog gi tshogs dang*/ rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang po'i rgyud nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis phyung ba/ jo bos bsnams nas byon/ mtshan 'dzin pa la'ang yon tan dpag tu med par bshad do// bcom ldan ral gris bkod pa'o// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das klu dbang gi rgyal po'i bstod pa rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs zhes bya ba/

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes srid gsum kun khyab cing*// nyin byed bye ba'i gzi brjid 'phrog byed pa'i// rgyal sras tshogs kyis mchog tu rab bstod pa// rgyal po'i dbang po mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// nyi ma'i drung du zla bas bgrod pa bzhin// dgra ngan dpung tshogs ma lus zil gyis gnon// rgya mtsho'i klong nas klu mchog ma lus pa// gus pa'i tshul gyis thal sbyar rab tu btud// ind+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar// thun mtshams sprin gyi mdog can bla gos 'dzin// chos sgrogs phyag rgya mi phyed thugs kar 'chings// rab mdzes gtsug na sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can// sngo bsangs nam mkha'i mdog can 'dab brgya pa// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus na mdzes// ku mud mdangs ldan sgrib pa rnam sel ba// rin chen myu gu yid 'ong bum pa 'dzin// dmar ba'i mdog can mi pham byams pa yis// klu shing me tog ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin// 'jam dpal gser mdog rab tu 'bar ba can// glegs bam ral gri yongs su 'dzin par mdzad// thugs rje chen pos dmar 'od me tog 'dzin// 'khor tshogs dpag med dbus na mngon mtho ba// mtha' yas zhing khams dpag med 'od zer 'gyed// tshul bzang yongs su rdzogs pa'i klu dbang la// gus pas bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang thob pas// dus gsum pha ma dang bcas 'gro ba rnams// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces klu dbang rgyal po la bstod pa rong ston gyis dpal nā lend+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// ༈ /klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo buddha nā gend+rā ya/ sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par sngon du song nas/

rang nyid skad cig gis sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra mā dzaḥ na mo nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥzhes phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas la/ tshogs zhing rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po de las 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ mgrin pa yan chad dkar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos dur smrig gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun gyen du phyogs pa'i chun po'i rgyab yol mnga' zhing sbrul mjug rnams gdan du bting ba/ de'i mdun du sgrib sel dkar po g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar por rin po ches mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang*/ g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal gzhon nu ser po utpa la'i steng na gnas pa'i ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/

g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad dkar 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta zhing pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad du dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ 'og tu klu'i tshogs thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs te gdong gyen du blta ba'o// spro na/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas rang gi thugs kar padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas skor du 'khor bar bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams kyis gtso byas sems can thams cad ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar mdzad/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag gcig gam bzhi la sogs pa bzlas pas mdze'i nad thams cad dang myong bar nges pa'i las thams cad kyang zad par 'gyur ro// thun las ldang ba'i tshe 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab nas/

rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /klu dbang rgyal po 'grub gyur nas// sogs kyis dge ba bsngo zhing chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// //klu dbang rgyal po lha lnga'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa'i mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ rdor dril dang me tog dgod/ bdag mdun bsgrubs nas slob mas maṇḍal dbul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma lha lngar bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ rtsa sngags la ā we sha ya btags pa dang*/ spos rol/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ bsams la sngags kyis bskor ba sogs spyi ltar/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga te bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhī na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ gsum sbyin/ gzung*| gsung*| maṇḍal dbus kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das tshon gang ba spros/ snying gar thim nas mnyam par gzhag thugs/ khas blang*/ yon dbul/ rjes 'dra'o// ༈ /'phags pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul go bde don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha nā gend+ra ya/ gang gi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// klu gdon gdug pa mthar byed pa// bla ma klu dbang rgyal po la// btud de de yi rjes gnang bri// 'dir sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po lha lnga'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ gnas dben par maṇḍa lar dri'i thig le dbus dang phyogs bzhir bkod pa'i steng 'bras dkar gyi tshom bu dbus ma che ba/ phyogs bzhir chung ba bkod pa'i mtha' skor ram mdun gang bder chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ dkar gtor zlum po mtheb skyus bskor ba gcig bcas bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu 'thor nas sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar sta gon bya/

stan bde ba la 'dug ste mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ āom̐ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyā āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥzhes phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas la/ tshogs zhing rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/

tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyug gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ mgrin pa yan chad dkar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun gyen du phyogs pa'i chun po'i rgyab yol mnga' zhing sbrul mjug rnams gdan du bting ba/ de'i mdun du sgrib sel dkar po g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar po rin po ches mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang g.yon ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal gzhon nu ser po utpa la'i steng na gnas pa'i ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad dkar 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta zhing pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad du dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ 'og tu klu'i tshogs thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs te gdong gyen du blta ba'o// spro na/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga te zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ rang gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas skor du 'khor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas klus gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar mdzad/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na adhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ bsnyen tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig gam bzhi la sogs pa bzlas pas mdze nad thams cad dang*/ myong bar nges pa'i las thams cad kyang byang bar 'gyur ro// thun las ldang bar 'dod na thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi nyer 'tshe la sogs pa las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /klu dbang rgyal po 'grub gyur nas sogs kyis dge ba bsngo zhing chos mthun gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de nas tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa zhes pa nas/ gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor bas gong bdag bskyed ltar brjod/ mchod pa rnams gong ltar bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bya/

mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes srid gsum kun khyab cing*// nyin byed bye ba'i gzi brjid 'phrog byed pa'i// rgyal sras tshogs kyis mchog tu rab bstod pa// rgyal po'i dbang po mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs te sngags ci nus bzla/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod pa las slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ 'o/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i chos la rgyal bas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad tshur bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus pa las 'dir theg pa chen po/ de la mdo rgyud gnyis las rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhir bzhugs pa las/ 'dir rig sngags 'chang ba'i sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang rgyud sde sgo drug las/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ de la rigs kyi gtso bo bdag po yum khro bo khro mo phyag brnyan pho mo rnams las 'dir rigs kyi gtso bor gyur pa mnyam med jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha nas nye bar brgyud de dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyis thugs dam gyis snying por mdzad pa klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa zhi ba la mchog tu bsngags pa sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/

sngon 'gro slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la sngon 'gro maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ dngos gzhi rjes gnang sbyin pa/ mjug yon dbul zhing dam tshig bsdus te khas blang ba gsum las/ dang po la slob dpon la klu dbang gi rgyal po dngos yin snyam pas maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga la yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag la sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags rnam smin sha rus kyis bsdus pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/

oṃ swa bhā wa shaddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ zhes brjod pas stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa zhes pa nas/ gdong gyen du blta ba dang bcas pa'i sku can du lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i rnam par byon pa'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam bsam gyis mi khyab par byon pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la rdo tshan la kha ba babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar ā we sha ya btags pa mang du brjod cing spos rol bya/ des klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ klu dbang rgyal po'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de ltar rjes zlos lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas dbu thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du klu dbang gi rgyal po yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ des klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob ces sogs gong gi rigs pa 'gre sbyar/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas klu dbang gi rgyal po'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug nas sib kyis thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi sogs/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob ces sogs gong gi rigs 'gre sbyar/

des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag tu dmigs te maṇḍal phul mdzod/ lus longs spyod kyang 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong*/ rjes ni mchod pa kha gsos bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bya/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs kyis bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol bya/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyis se gol dang badzra muḥzhes tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bsngo smon bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// 'phags pa nā gardzu nas legs bkral ba'i// klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// dam pa'i gsung bzhin gsal bar bkod zin gyi// dpyod ldan tshogs rnams dga' ba'i gar byos shig /ces sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po lha lnga'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa go bde don tshang gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di'ang klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don mchog legs rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ bstod pa rong ston gyis mdzad pa sogs bsgrigs/ rje bla mas phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa'i gsung rgyun ltar rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal gyi bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal shāka btsun lhun grub kyis dben gnas rmor dgon par bris pa'o// ༈ /sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po'i bsnyen thabs bris sku'i dmigs bsal bcas bzhugs/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod pas/

'di'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis/ sha chang dang sgog btsong sogs sme ba'i zas spang*/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas nas spyi dang bye brag gi rten yod na bsham/ dkar gtor gsum dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste 'di sgrub thabs tshig tshogs nyung bas thun bzhi bya/ snga thun dgongs thun gang rigs kyi rjes su gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma chu gtsang gi bran/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dmigs rten yod na de dang dbyer med du bsam/ gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas dbul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas par byed na rong ston chen pos mdzad pa ltar bya/ bsdu na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu gnyan sa bdag gi nyer 'tshe la sogs pa las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas la/ lag pa g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/

oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas 'jig rten skyong ba rnams spyan drangs/ sngags de nyid la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas dbul/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis phrin las gzhol/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa ni/ dkar gtor cha bzhi nas 'byung ba'i klu gtor gyi gtong ngo*// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum phrag bzhi mdzad cing*/ phan yon dang las tshogs rnams gzhung du blta'o// bris sku bri na/ sgrub thabs su cung zad mi gsal ba 'di lta ste/ 'og gzhi rgya mtsho'i nang nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khri pad sdong skyes shing*/ mtsho las klu sna tshogs pas thal mo sbyar bas nor bu 'dzin cing gdong bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal la blta ba/ gzhan yang chu gnas kyi sems can thams cad rtse zhing rol pa ste bkod pa ci mdzes rin po che du mas gtams pa/ 'khor gyi byang sems bzhi ni/ sgrib sel phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar steng 'og tu me tog padma'i yu ba 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan thad du kha gyes pa'i g.yas su rin po che'i myu gu/ g.yon bum pa/ byams pa chos 'chad kyis g.yas klu shing me tog bcas/ g.yon padma'i steng du ril ba spyi blugs te yu ba gnyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'jam dpal yang chos 'chad ral pod 'dzin pa/ spyan ras gzigs g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon padma thugs kar 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan thad gyes pa/ bzhi kas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba/ rgyan na bza' sogs sgrub thabs su gsal/ steng gi cha la dgra bcom pa'i tshogs mang po/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ jo bo yab sras sogs bri'o// zhes pa 'di'ang dge slong kun dga' rgya mtsho sogs don gnyer du mas bskul ngor sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /swa sti/ klu gtor bsdus pa ni/

gtor ma la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas ma dag pa bsang*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra dzwā la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gzi byin bskyed/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ādya nutpanna twātra oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rin po che'i snod yangs pa bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis gang zhing ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsams te/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bye brag tu rang la gnod par byed pa'i klu'i rigs thams cad spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ| klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu// padma padma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen mo dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu lunta// dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po tshe li dang*// tshe li chen po rnams dang ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhurbhu waḥphruṃ phruṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod pas mdun du byon par bsam/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ swā hā/ puṣpaṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gandhaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod la/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya dang*/

oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha dzruṃ phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas phul nas/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣān ta thā ga to hya wa datra/ te ṣātstsha yo ni ro dha e wam̐ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs pa spyod// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtso byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu yang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing mnyes par gyur cig gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa nye bar zhi nas phan pa dang bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig ces dang*/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta yo gatstsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes brjod pas nag po'i rigs kyi klu thams cad bskrad par bsam mo// zhes pa 'di ni dpal sa skya pa'i dkar gtor cha bzhi'i ngag 'don ltar bris pa'o// //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
